item.title: Rise of the DAO’s with James Duncan by This Week in Crypto
item.description: James Duncan is the co-founder at Abridged, a toolkit for rapid blockchain application development. Previously, James worked at the Ethereum Foundation, managing a multimillion-dollar grant budget that funded projects like Gitcoin, Uniswap, and DappNode. In this week’s episode, we discuss the history of DAOs, DAO structures, and uses for DAOs in a regulated environment. Show Links Vitalik on “DAC” in 2013 MolochDAO Signal DAO Abridged on Gitcoin Newsletter 👉 https://mota.fm/sub

item.title: Kyber Network On-Chain Token Swaps And Decentralized Liquidity Pool by This Week in Crypto
item.description: Kyber Network is an Ethereum-based protocol that allows for the instant exchange and conversion of digital assets and cryptocurrencies with high liquidity. It’s similar to the 0x project but instead performs all its actions on the blockchain. Deniz Omer, Head of Growth at Kyber Network, joins us to discuss decentralized liquidity, challenges of decentralized exchanges and his thoughts on the recent bZx exploit that resulted in a loss of roughly $350k. 📧 Read the full story 📖 Sign up for our news

item.title: Orchid Decentralized VPNs And Following The White Rabbit by This Week in Crypto
item.description: Orchid is building open source tools for custom VPN configurations and privacy services. item.title: Aave Flash Loans And Lending Protocol by This Week in Crypto
item.description: Aave is an open-source and non-custodial protocol to earn interest on deposits and borrow assets with a variable or stable interest rate. item.title: 3Box Shared Backend Platform For Web3 Applications by This Week in Crypto
item.description: 3Box is an open-source data storage solution for web3 that allows end-users to manage their public and private information on the decentralized web. 3Box CEO Michael Sena joins me to discuss blockchain identity, decentralized storage, and enabling applications with zero backends. 📧 Read the full story 📖 Sign up for our newsletter 🐣 Follow us on Twitter

item.title: P2P Trading, Atomic Swaps, and Node Operators with RADAR by This Week in Crypto
item.description: RADAR is building products for access to financial infrastructure. Its REDSHIFT product bridges payments between the Bitcoin Lightning Network and Ethereum. They've also built ION, which services to educate and onboard users to the Lightning Network. Their latest project, DEPLOY is a node operations platform that helps developers spin up and maintain blockchain infrastructure. RELAY is a peer-to-peer trading platform built on the 0x protocol. 📧 Read the full story 📖 Sign up for our newsletter 🐣

item.title: SKALE Blockchain Smart Contract Scaling by This Week in Crypto
item.description: SKALE Labs is a blockchain scalability platform that provides high-speed consensus and empowers dApps to run smart contracts. SKALE acts as a middle-ware layer which provides high-speed consensus and empowers dApps to run smart contracts at the rate of millions per second on platforms such as Ethereum, EOS, and other Smart Contract Blockchain platforms. 📧 Read the full story 📖 Sign up for our newsletter 🐣 Follow us on Twitter

item.title: 2019 Crypto Tax Filing And What You Should Know by This Week in Crypto
item.description: TokenTax reports cryptocurrency capital gains and income taxes and supports over 30 exchanges. TokenTax provides a global perspective on crypto tax regulations as well as common practices for U.S. taxpayers. Zac McClure, co-founder of TokenTax, will join us to discuss the implications of taxes on cryptocurrency. Subscribe to our newsletter 👉 here.
